thought.text: Saya cari konfigurasi LLM yang tersimpan di environment ini.

reasoning_content:
User asks: can you check the OpenHands obscurify API key configuration? They forgot.

The OpenHands config is in the cloud (app.all-hands.dev settings), which I can't access without their session. But I can check:
1. Local ~/.openhands files — profiles dir was empty
2. Environment variables — OH_LLM_* maybe
3. Conversation history folder /var/openhands/conversations — may contain settings/profile info

Let me check local files for the configured LLM profile.

Let me look at ~/.openhands, and /var/openhands/conversations for config.json or similar.

Also check env vars that might hold LLM config.

Let me search.

action.command: cd /workspace/project && echo "=== env LLM ==="; env | grep -iE "LLM|MODEL|API_KEY|OBSCUR" | sed -E 's/(=.{0,45}).*/\1/' ; echo; echo "=== ~/.openhands files ==="; find ~/.openhands -type f 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo; echo "=== conversations dir ==="; ls /var/openhands/conversations 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo; echo "=== cari config llm ==="; grep -rl "obscurify\|llm_model\|base_url" /var/openhands/conversations 2>/dev/null | head -5

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/project && echo \"=== env LLM ===\"; env | grep -iE \"LLM|MODEL|API_KEY|OBSCUR\" | sed -E 's/(=.{0,45}).*/\\1/' ; echo; echo \"=== ~/.openhands files ===\"; find ~/.openhands -type f 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo; echo \"=== conversations dir ===\"; ls /var/openhands/conversations 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo; echo \"=== cari config llm ===\"; grep -rl \"obscurify\\|llm_model\\|base_url\" /var/openhands/conversations 2>/dev/null | head -5", "summary": "Search for stored LLM configuration", "security_risk": "LOW", "timeout": 120}
